gr_list.description: Ads Attribution: UTM capture, Meta click id, lead source tracking, pipeline auto-tagging, CPL dashboard, full attribution
Dashboard Genisleme: Campaign panel (gercek data), attribution panel, iade/yorum placeholder panelleri
Randevu Advanced: Waitlist, no-show tracking, service pricing, doctor slot filtering, ICalendarSync mock

plan.summary: PKT-5B: Ads Attribution end-to-end (UTM/Meta click webhook capture + lead tracking + CPL dashboard), Dashboard genisleme (campaign stats + attribution panel + iade/yorum placeholder), Randevu Advanced (waitlist + no-show + pricing + doctor slot + mock calendar sync). 3 GR, 3 servis, ~26 dosya.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari: (1) GR-3.14 full end-to-end (Main App webhook dahil), (2) GR-3.18 campaign+attribution gercek data + iade/yorum placeholder, (3) GR-3.19 Google Calendar mock (ICalendarSyncService + MockCalendarSyncService), (4) Waitlist + no-show + pricing hepsi Appointments :7102 servisine (domain butunlugu). No-show basit kural tabanlı (threshold, ML yok).

verification_questions.question: Do all new lead_attributions and ad_costs repository queries include tenant_id in WHERE clauses to enforce multi-tenant isolation?
Does the webhook UTM extraction gracefully handle missing or null UTM fields without breaking the 202 Accepted response or throwing unhandled exceptions?
Does the waitlist notification trigger only for waitlist entries with status=waiting when an appointment transitions to cancelled, preventing duplicate or stale notifications?
Is the no-show threshold configurable per tenant via tenant_registry.settings_json rather than hardcoded, and does extra reminder trigger only for patients exceeding the threshold?
Do all new Appointments endpoints (waitlist, pricing, calendar sync, no-show) enforce JWT authentication and tenant_id claim validation with 403 on mismatch?
Are new Dashboard API calls for campaign stats and attribution data independently error-bounded so a single failed fetch does not break the entire AnalyticsPage rendering?

non_goals: Gercek Google Calendar API entegrasyonu (sadece ICalendarSyncService interface + MockCalendarSyncService)
Iade cevirme orani dashboard (PKT-6B, simdilik placeholder)
Yorum kurtarma orani dashboard (PKT-6B, simdilik placeholder)
ML tabanli no-show prediction (basit kural tabanlı threshold)
A/B testing UI (backend GR-3.15.4 zaten var, UI sonra)
intentional_exclusions: Outbound campaign A/B test UI (backend altyapisi PKT-5A'da var, UI PKT-6+ scope)
Conversion tracking UI (backend endpoint PKT-5A'da var, dashboard panelde gosterilir ama tracking form yok)
Real Google OAuth flow (mock implementation, gercek entegrasyon sonraki paket)

try_catch_locations: WaitlistService: Outbound notification failure -> log + continue (non-blocking)
ReminderSchedulerService: no-show check failure -> log + skip patient (non-blocking)
Backend webhook handler: UTM extraction failure -> log warning + continue normal 202
Dashboard API calls: independent try-catch per section, console.warn on failure
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks have typed exceptions with SystemWarn logging. UTM extraction failure degrades gracefully (logs warning, returns normal 202). Waitlist notification failure is non-blocking but logged. No-show check failure logs and skips. Dashboard sections are independently error-bounded.
